# routeros_routing_pimsm_instance (Resource)
Manage `/routing/pimsm/instance`. Requires RouterOS 7.25.1 or later and the corresponding hardware/package. [CLI reference](https://manual.mikrotik.com/docs/7.25/cli-reference/routing/pimsm/instance/).

## Example Usage
```terraform
# RouterOS 7.25.1+. Check the menu's package and hardware requirements.
resource "routeros_routing_pimsm_instance" "example" {
  name     = "multicast-v6"
  vrf      = "main"
  afi      = "ipv6"
  disabled = true
}
```
